test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The error in the sentence "Rama can bowl fastly" is the use of "fastly" as an adverb modifying the verb "bowl".

• The correct adverbial form for "fast" remains "fast", not "fastly". "Fast" serves as both an adjective and an adverb.

• When describing the manner of an action (in this case, the manner in which Rama bowls), the correct adverb should be used.

• Therefore, the correct form of the sentence should use "fast" as the adverb, resulting in "Rama can bowl fast".

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *Rama can bowl **fast**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• "Go back to your room" is a correct imperative sentence giving a command.

• "Don’t talk so loudly" is a correct negative imperative sentence advising someone not to do something in a certain way.

• "Run quickly" is a correct imperative sentence using the adverb "quickly" to describe how to run.
